_comment: JWK alg-selection vectors (issue #179), written by `go run ./cross-test/jwk-alg/genvectors`; do not edit by hand. Each case names a key in `jwks` (by kid) and a signed token; a language test builds that JWK, verifies the token against it, and must reach `expect` (reject: the JWK is refused, the token does not parse, or verification fails). The accepted algs come from the key: RSA RS256/RS384/RS512, EC by curve (P-256 ES256, P-384 ES384), OKP Ed25519 EdDSA, narrowed to the key's alg when it declares one; never none, HMAC or PS*. `jwks.microsoft` is shaped like https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/discovery/v2.0/keys (no alg; x5t, x5c, issuer). Throwaway keys; exp is 2100-01-01.
